title: Tropical Storm Arthur forms near Texas coast - NewsBreak
text:
By Kelsey Peck No media credit provided. ,
11 hours ago
PANAMA CITY, Fla. (WMBB) – The first named tropical system of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season formed in the Gulf Wednesday morning.
Tropical Storm Arthur has sustained winds of 40 mph and is moving NE at 9 mph.
It’s expected to make landfall in Louisiana later Wednesday night.
What impacts will the Panhandle see? The Panhandle won’t see direct impacts as it will start to weaken as it goes over land, however we will see feeder bands and the remnants by Thursday afternoon.
This system increases the area’s rain chances with 5-7 inches expected in our northern counties and 2-5 inches for the rest of our viewing area. There is a marginal risk for severe weather on Thursday.
The entire Panhandle will be under a flood watch starting Thursday morning through Saturday.
